directos.sub: Live classes with your students. They show up in the calendar and students get a reminder before they start.
directos.enlace: Your video call link (Zoom, Google Meet, Teams…)
directos.enlaceAyuda: Paste the link you use to connect. Your students will join through it.
directos.zoomPorMi: Create the Zoom meeting for me
directos.zoomPorMiAyuda: Your academy has Zoom connected: we can create the meeting without you pasting anything.
directos.enlaceMal: The link must start with https://
directos.faltaEnlace: Paste your video call link so your students can join.
directos.sinZoom: Paste your video call link (Zoom, Google Meet or Teams) or connect your Zoom account in the advanced options under Settings.
directos.error: Could not save the class. Try again.
directos.borrarConfirmar: Cancel this class? Anyone who signed up will be told.
directos.apuntados: {n, plural, =0 {Nobody signed up yet} one {# signed up} other {# signed up}}
directos.vacioTexto: A weekly live class is what brings your students back the most. Set a day and time, paste your video call link and you are done: it shows up in their calendar and we remind them beforehand.

alumnos.sub: Who is in your academy and how to bring more people in.
alumnos.compartirTexto: Anyone who buys through this link goes straight into your course. Share it on WhatsApp, social media or your website.
alumnos.sinEnlaceTexto: Your sales link shows up here once you publish your course.
alumnos.quienVeAyuda: Choose which courses and spaces each group of students can see.
alumnos.vacioTexto: Your students will show up here as soon as they buy or you invite them. Start with the people who already follow you: invite them by email or send them your link.

ajustes.comunidad: How it looks in the community
ajustes.comunidadAyuda: Your academy’s card next to the community feed, like a Skool group’s.
ajustes.nombreAyuda: It is what your students see at the very top.
ajustes.marcaAyuda: Until you upload your logo, the Didacta one is used. Once you upload it, your logo and colour replace Didacta's.
ajustes.faltaNombre: Write the name of your academy.
ajustes.modoTexto: You will see every advanced option in a side menu. You can come back to the simple mode whenever you like.
ajustes.modoConfirmar: Switch to the full mode? You can come back whenever you like.
ajustes.avanzadasAyuda: Email, payments with your own account, Zoom, language and more.

cursos.sub: What you sell and what your students learn.
cursos.vacioTexto: A course is a set of lessons (videos, texts or files) your students follow at their own pace. It is what you are going to sell: one lesson is enough to start.
